meta_title: Beacon Farm Forestry | Tree Surgery Birmingham
meta_description: Beacon Farm Forestry provides expert tree surgery, crown reduction, and stump removal across Birmingham and Walsall. Local arborists, fully insured. Call today.
hero_subhead: Safe tree surgery, pruning, and removal when you need it. Same-week appointments available.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: From hazard assessment to full removal, we handle every aspect of tree care safely and sustainably.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe, controlled felling of dead, diseased, or unwanted trees. We handle difficult access and tight gardens with precision machinery and experienced crews.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Reduce height and spread without harming the tree. Improves light to your garden and reduces storm damage risk, with a finished shape in one visit.

services.title: Stump Grinding
services.desc: Complete below-ground removal leaves your garden clear and ready for replanting. Faster and neater than chemical stump removal.

services.title: Tree Inspection & Risk Assessment
services.desc: Professional surveys identify hazardous branches or weak growth before they become expensive problems. Fully documented reports for insurance claims.

services.title: Storm Damage & Emergency Response
services.desc: Fallen trees blocking access or threatening your property? We prioritise emergency call-outs and make the site safe the same day.

services.title: Hedge Cutting & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular trimming keeps hedges healthy and attractive. We respect nesting seasons and local wildlife while keeping your boundaries neat.

about_pullquote: We treat every tree like it belongs to a neighbour we respect.
about_para_1: Beacon Farm Forestry has been caring for trees across Birmingham and Walsall for 18 years. Founded by experienced arborists who started out doing contract work for local councils and estates, we've built our reputation on honest advice and meticulous safety. Every team member is fully qualified and insured, with specialist training in hazardous tree work and wildlife protection.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we explain what a tree needs — not just what we can sell them. Whether you're dealing with a storm-damaged oak or a overgrown garden hedge, we give free no-pressure assessments and get the work done right. We recycle 100% of waste as wood chip and logs, keeping our environmental footprint small.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a huge oak leaning over the house. Beacon Farm sent someone round for a free look, explained everything clearly, and the crew made light work of it. Cost less than the other quotes, and they cleaned up properly after. Wouldn't hesitate to use them again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Emergency call after the storm — they came out same day, made the fallen beech safe, and got it removed within 48 hours. Professional, quick, and reasonable on price. Really impressed with how they handled it.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: Regular hedge trim twice a year keeps our boundary looking smart. They know exactly when to cut to protect the birds nesting in spring. Top service, very reliable, and they always turn up on time.
reviews.author: Peter K.
